mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_flow (item_id, change_amount, change_type, ref_type, ref_id, warehouse_id, created_at) VALUES (#{itemId}, #{changeAmount}, #{changeType}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{warehouseId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stock_flow ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM stock_flow WHERE item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM stock_flow ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(sf.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.change_amount > 0 THEN sf.change_amount ELSE 0 END) as inQuantity, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.change_amount < 0 THEN ABS(sf.change_amount) ELSE 0 END) as outQuantity FROM stock_flow sf
JOIN item i ON sf.item_id = i.id
WHERE sf.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
AND sf.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
AND i.category = #{category}
AND i.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{itemName}, '%')
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(sf.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM stock_flow WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
SELECT item_id as itemId, MAX(created_at) as lastDate FROM stock_flow GROUP BY item_id
